saw_lines: Bowlers buy shirts for their league, often as a team set, so a captain usually orders for the whole lineup.
So the sale is won when the captain finds team pricing and custom names on the first page he lands on.
Your site runs 20% off polos and free shipping over $85, so lead the next batch of your 22 Google ads with that polo offer in the first headline.
